name: Inkshield
oracle_text: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to you this turn. For each 1 damage prevented this way, create a 2/1 white and black Inkling creature token with flying.
blocked_sentences: For each 1 damage prevented this way, create a 2/1 white and black Inkling creature token with flying.

needs.what: a link from a resolved prevention shield to the amount it later prevents: each time the shield installed by this spell prevents N damage, its controller creates N inkling_2_1_wb_flying tokens (a delayed trigger keyed to that specific shield, carrying the prevented amount as a value)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The damage_prevented trigger event exists, but a delayed_trigger on it has no filter tying the event to the shield this spell made ("prevented this way") and no value_keys entry reads the event's prevented amount, so create_token's amount cannot be the number of damage prevented
